name: dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate
title: Payment AP2 Mandate Extension
description: Extends Checkout with cryptographic mandate support for non-repudiable authorization per the AP2 protocol, and optionally extends Order with signed, mandate-bound receipts for money movements after checkout. Uses embedded signature model with ap2 namespace.

merchant_authorization.title: Merchant Authorization
merchant_authorization.description: JWS Detached Content signature (RFC 7515 Appendix F) over the checkout response body (excluding ap2 field). Format: `<base64url-header>..<base64url-signature>`. The header MUST contain 'alg' (ES256/ES384/ES512) and 'kid' claims. The signature covers both the header and JCS-canonicalized checkout payload.

checkout_mandate.title: Checkout Mandate
checkout_mandate.description: SD-JWT+kb credential in `ap2.checkout_mandate`. Proving user authorization for the checkout. Contains the full checkout including `ap2.merchant_authorization`.

ap2_with_merchant_authorization.description: AP2 extension data including merchant authorization.

merchant_authorization.description: Merchant's signature proving checkout terms are authentic.

ap2_with_checkout_mandate.description: AP2 extension data including checkout mandate.

checkout_mandate.description: SD-JWT+kb proving user authorized this checkout.

receipt.title: Order Receipt
receipt.description: Compact JWS (RFC 7515) signed by the business over one money movement on an AP2-negotiated Order. Format: `<base64url-header>.<base64url-payload>.<base64url-signature>`. The header MUST contain 'alg' (per the AP2 extension's algorithm rule), 'kid' (resolving in the issuing business's `keys[]`), and 'typ' set to `ucp-ap2-receipt+jwt`. The payload is the JCS-canonicalized (RFC 8785) Receipt Payload.

receipt_hash.title: Receipt Hash
receipt_hash.description: `sha-256:` followed by the unpadded base64url SHA-256 digest of the referenced artifact's exact UTF-8 bytes.

receipt_event.title: Receipt Event
receipt_event.description: The single money movement a receipt attests to.

type.description: Kind of money movement. `authorization` and `authorization_adjustment` add to `authorized`; `release` subtracts from it; `capture` adds to `captured`; `capture_reversal` subtracts from it; `refund` adds to `refunded`.

status.description: Outcome of the movement. Only `succeeded` events change the running totals.

amount.description: Amount of this movement in minor units of `currency`. Always non-negative; `type` gives the direction.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. MUST match the Order currency.

occurred_at.description: When the movement occurred (RFC 3339). Receipts are ordered by `seq`, not by this time.

seller_id.description: Seller of record the movement applies to, when seller attribution is active on the Order.

network_ref.description: Network or acquirer reference for the movement, e.g. the Acquirer Reference Number (ARN) of a refund. MAY first appear on a follow-up receipt with the same `type` and `ref.processing_entry_id`, which does not change the totals, and MAY never be present, e.g. for a refund the processor settles as a reversal.

ref.description: Links the movement to other Order data.

adjustment_id.description: `id` of the Order `adjustments[]` entry this movement settles (e.g. a refund).

processing_entry_id.description: Identifier of the corresponding payment processing entry. A later `succeeded` receipt with the same `type` and `processing_entry_id` is a follow-up and does not change the totals again.

receipt_totals.title: Receipt Totals
receipt_totals.description: Running totals for the receipt's chain after this event, in minor units. Platforms recompute these from the succeeded events they hold.

mandated.description: `payment_amount` of the closed Payment Mandate this chain spends against.

authorized.description: Sum of succeeded `authorization` and `authorization_adjustment` amounts minus succeeded `release` amounts. Captures do not reduce it.

captured.description: Sum of succeeded `capture` amounts minus succeeded `capture_reversal` amounts.

receipt_payload.title: Receipt Payload
receipt_payload.description: Claims signed inside an Order Receipt. Receipts form one hash-chained sequence per `(iss, mandate_ref)` pair.

iss.description: Profile URI of the business whose `ap2.merchant_authorization` the referenced Payment Mandate covers. In a marketplace that is merchant of record, this is the marketplace.

iat.description: Issue time, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

mandate_ref.description: Hash of the closed Payment Mandate this event spends against, computed over the exact string carried in `payment.instruments[*].credential.token`.

seq.description: Position in the `(iss, mandate_ref)` chain. Starts at 1 and increases by exactly 1.

prev.description: Hash of the previous receipt's compact JWS in the same chain; `null` when `seq` is 1.

ap2_with_receipts.description: AP2 extension data on an Order.

receipts.description: Every receipt issued for the Order, each chain in `seq` order.

order_receipts_config.title: Order Receipts Config
order_receipts_config.description: Optional `order_receipts` member of the `dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate` capability `config`. Order receipts are required only when both the business and platform profiles declare it.

events.description: In the business profile, the event types the business issues receipts for. In the platform profile, informational: the event types the platform can process.

receipt_verification_outcome.title: Receipt Verification Outcome
receipt_verification_outcome.description: Outcomes a platform records when verifying Order receipts. These are not returned as errors; the business has already moved the money.
